name: Iran nuclear programme
summary: No inspections in Iran; Trump says 'one or two' targets remain
state: The IAEA has had no access to Iranian sites and reported Iran to the UN Security Council on 1 Oct. Trump said on 31 Oct that the US still has 'one or two' targets in Iran and said on 1 Nov the war would end 'very soon, one way or the other'. Iran has warned that a renewed war could last longer than the previous phase.
for_you: No direct public safety risk outside the region. Travel advice for Iran and the Gulf is on the FCDO website.
rubric_hit: No IAEA access; credible threats of further strikes

sources.title: Gulf News — Trump says US still has to take care of one or two targets in Iran
Al Jazeera — Iran war live: Tankers hit in Hormuz; Trump again says conflict to end soon

why: A nuclear-armed Iran — or strikes to prevent one — could ignite the Gulf and send oil far higher.
drivers: Enrichment levels, IAEA access, Israeli/US military posture, snapback sanctions, talks.

rubric.alert: Strikes on nuclear sites, NPT withdrawal, or evidence of weaponisation.
rubric.watch: Enrichment at ≥ 60% or inspector access curtailed, or credible strike threats.
rubric.normal: IAEA access and active diplomacy; no escalation.
